headline: Anderson make it six wins without defeat
dek: Anderson beat North Greenville at home on Tuesday for their sixth win of the season and remain unbeaten, with twenty scored and eight conceded. Catawba, unbeaten too, sit level with them at the top of the table, and the two do not meet until the middle of October.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-two and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Lenoir-Rhyne are the only side still without a win, and have conceded more goals than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne are still without a win: three draws and five defeats, ten scored and twenty-one conceded, the latest a home defeat to Emory & Henry on Wednesday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry's win at Lenoir-Rhyne on Wednesday was their first published result that was not a draw: one win and two draws, six scored and three conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Newberry's run of two wins ended at Coker on Wednesday; they have two wins and six defeats, ten scored and eighteen conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made twenty-nine saves and conceded five goals.

last_match.line: Emory & Henry's first win of the season; Lenoir-Rhyne have still not won.

next_match.line: Anderson have still not lost; Wingate have lost their last two at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
